# Demo: Large Estate (25 Services, 8-Service LOCAL Slice)

InMemoryWorld-only scaling scenario: 25 services, 8-service LOCAL checkout-slice Profile, Gateway Reconciliation, bare start, and single-service drift.

## Step 1: Apply the 8-service LOCAL checkout-slice Profile and reconcile the Gateway across 25 services

```console
$ procomp profile use checkout-slice
Applied profile 'checkout-slice' (8 LOCAL, 17 REMOTE)

$ procomp gateway start
Gateway: spawned MANAGED (procomp) [PID 10000, HEALTHY] -> http://127.0.0.1:18080

$ procomp gateway reconcile
Gateway: reconciled 25 route mapping(s) on http://127.0.0.1:18080 (IN_SYNC)

$ procomp gateway status
Gateway:         wiremock (http://127.0.0.1:18080)
Port:            18080
Owner:           MANAGED (procomp)
Health:          HEALTHY
PID:             10000
Uptime:          5s
Sync Status:     IN_SYNC
```
